project.name: ville
project.one_liner: A pipeline + open spec (cityPack, CC0) + PSX/Shenmue web viewer + essay series for reconstructing lost urban geometry from historical sources with epoch-appropriate ML, beginning with Paris, Roman Lutèce to now.
project.full_context: VILLE is the historical-reconstruction continuation of Sixth Borough (present-day NYC 3D) and Eyes on the Street. It reconstructs lost urban geometry from sparse archival photos, engravings, and archaeological constraint. The intellectual spine is research-grade BUILD-TIME ML (DUSt3R / MASt3R / VGGT, Gaussian Splatting, constrained diffusion) with ZERO runtime ML — the viewer is a pure renderer of pre-baked packs. Every reconstructed element carries a mandatory synthesis_tier in {none,minimal,light,mixed,heavy} so fabulation is always declared, never silent. First city: Paris. First block target: one Île-de-la-Cité block pre-Haussmann with rich Marville (1860s-70s) photo coverage. Full vision, phase plan, and locked theses live in docs/manifesto.md — read it before touching anything. This is a body of work, not a startup: one solo steward, public from day one, no scale/VC/growth/app-store framing (see docs/NOT.md).
hard_rules: ZERO runtime ML. The viewer renders pre-baked packs only; no model ships to the device. Non-negotiable (docs/NOT.md).
Per-field provenance is mandatory: every geometry element in a pack has a provenance.jsonl row with WHO + WHEN + LICENSE + synthesis_tier.
synthesis_tier ∈ {none, minimal, light, mixed, heavy}. No element may omit it. Heavy/mixed tiers are declared fabulation under provenance, never passed off as record.
Spec (/spec) is CC0. Code (/pipeline, /viewer) is MIT. Pack contents (/packs) carry per-upstream-source licenses declared per element.
The loop NEVER self-certifies a human_gate milestone. It prepares the artifact and stops; Alex renders the verdict. Applies to M3 reconstruction quality, M6 essay quality.

This codebase is written by an AI loop: comments minimal and only where they inform the next iteration; test only what must survive repeated runs (schema validity, provenance completeness, budget of synthesis tiers).
Body of work, not startup. If a milestone drifts toward scale / recurring revenue / app-store / co-founder framing, stop and re-read docs/NOT.md.
